# haziqbuilds — Syed Muhammad Haziq

> Freelance web developer based in Malaysia. Builds focused landing pages,
> sales pages and lightweight business websites for businesses, organisations
> and personal brands. Custom web systems (bookings, dashboards, accounts)
> are also possible, but are quoted individually and are not part of the
> website packages.

## Services

- Landing Page: a focused one-page website for a business, campaign, service, event or personal brand.
- Sales Page: a conversion-focused page that explains one offer and pushes visitors toward one action.
- Business Website: a lightweight multi-section or small multi-page website for a stronger online presence.

## Pricing (one-time development fees, MYR)

- Starter: RM499. One page, up to five sections, design adapted to your brand, responsive layout, WhatsApp contact, basic page SEO, 1 revision round.
- Business: RM899. Up to three pages, more tailored layout, services or gallery sections, light help organising supplied copy, page-level basic SEO, 2 revision rounds.
- Custom website: from RM1,500. More individual design, up to five standard pages as the starting scope; extra features quoted separately.
- Custom web systems: quoted individually. A database, booking engine, payments, dashboard, user accounts or ongoing support are not included in the website packages.

Domain and hosting are paid to third-party providers and are separate from the development fee. Domains are registered in the customer's name where practical. A simple static site may fit a free hosting tier, but free hosting is not guaranteed long term.

After launch: 30 days of fixes for bugs within the agreed scope. Optional care plan for static sites: RM300 per year, with a quarterly check and up to four small content updates a year, each taking up to 30 minutes (unused updates do not carry over). The care plan is not mandatory. New features, extra pages, major changes, substantial content writing and third-party charges are quoted separately.

Payment: 50% development deposit and 50% when the agreed site is accepted, before launch. Quotations are valid for 14 days.
